interfaces.label: Backplane connector
interfaces.desc: Plugs into a backplane slot. Carries CAN, the 1-Wire temperature bus and the 5 V supply.

interfaces.label: Ethernet
interfaces.desc: Gigabit Ethernet of the Compute Module 5.

interfaces.label: HDMI
interfaces.desc: Video output (HDMI0 of the Compute Module 5).

interfaces.label: USB 3.0 (Type-A)
interfaces.desc: USB 3.0 host port with a current-limited 5 V supply.

interfaces.label: USB 3.0 (Type-C)
interfaces.desc: USB 3.0 port. Its VBUS is tied to the 5 V rail, so it can also power the board.

interfaces.label: Camera 0
interfaces.desc: 4-lane MIPI CSI camera interface with I²C and 3.3 V.

interfaces.label: Camera 1
interfaces.desc: 4-lane MIPI CSI camera interface with I²C and 3.3 V.

interfaces.label: M.2 slot
interfaces.desc: PCIe slot with its own switched 3.3 V supply, for a 2230 or 2242 SSD.

interfaces.label: Configuration jumpers
interfaces.desc: Jumpers to GND for nRPIBOOT, EEPROM write protect, Wi-Fi disable, Bluetooth disable, PMIC enable and the power button; also breaks out the Ethernet sync output.

interfaces.label: RTC battery
interfaces.desc: Backup battery for the real-time clock of the Compute Module 5.
